sub_parameters.name: cleanup_cloud_resources
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to clean up associated cloud resources when uninstalling the component. Valid values:
- true: Clean up.
- false: Retain.

sub_parameters.name: name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the component to uninstall. You can call the [ListClusterAddonInstances](~~2667940~~) operation to query the components installed in a cluster.
